batter_last100_contact_rate.calculation: classified contact pitches / classified swing pitches, using the frozen CONTACT_PITCH_RESULTS and SWING_PITCH_RESULTS vocabularies
batter_last100_contact_rate.cutoff: source.gameDate < target.game_date; the source calendar day must be complete; the target PA, every other PA on the target date (including doubleheaders), and every future PA are excluded
batter_last100_contact_rate.missing: null when the window contains zero classifiable swings; batter_last100_whiff_missing=1
batter_last100_contact_rate.window: last min(100, prior PA count) resolved PAs for the same canonical batter

batter_last100_insufficient.cutoff: source.gameDate < target.game_date; the source calendar day must be complete; the target PA, every other PA on the target date (including doubleheaders), and every future PA are excluded
batter_last100_insufficient.missing: never null; an empty history is explicitly insufficient
batter_last100_insufficient.window: last min(100, prior PA count) resolved PAs for the same canonical batter

batter_last100_pa_count.cutoff: source.gameDate < target.game_date; the source calendar day must be complete; the target PA, every other PA on the target date (including doubleheaders), and every future PA are excluded
batter_last100_pa_count.missing: 0.0 when no eligible prior PA exists
batter_last100_pa_count.window: last min(100, prior PA count) resolved PAs for the same canonical batter

batter_last100_strikeout_rate.calculation: count(paEvent in {strikeout, strikeout_double_play}) divided by batter_last100_pa_count
batter_last100_strikeout_rate.cutoff: source.gameDate < target.game_date; the source calendar day must be complete; the target PA, every other PA on the target date (including doubleheaders), and every future PA are excluded
batter_last100_strikeout_rate.missing: null when batter_last100_pa_count is zero; never filled from a later date
batter_last100_strikeout_rate.window: last min(100, prior PA count) resolved PAs for the same canonical batter

batter_last100_walk_hbp_rate.calculation: count(paEvent in {walk, intent_walk, hit_by_pitch}) divided by batter_last100_pa_count
batter_last100_walk_hbp_rate.cutoff: source.gameDate < target.game_date; the source calendar day must be complete; the target PA, every other PA on the target date (including doubleheaders), and every future PA are excluded
batter_last100_walk_hbp_rate.missing: null when batter_last100_pa_count is zero; never filled from a later date
batter_last100_walk_hbp_rate.window: last min(100, prior PA count) resolved PAs for the same canonical batter

batter_last100_whiff_missing.calculation: 1.0 when the last-100-PA window contains zero classifiable swings, otherwise 0.0
batter_last100_whiff_missing.cutoff: source.gameDate < target.game_date; the source calendar day must be complete; the target PA, every other PA on the target date (including doubleheaders), and every future PA are excluded
batter_last100_whiff_missing.missing: never null; it is the missingness indicator for both contact and whiff rates
batter_last100_whiff_missing.window: last min(100, prior PA count) resolved PAs for the same canonical batter

batter_last100_whiff_rate.calculation: classified whiff pitches / classified swing pitches, using the frozen WHIFF_PITCH_RESULTS and SWING_PITCH_RESULTS vocabularies
batter_last100_whiff_rate.cutoff: source.gameDate < target.game_date; the source calendar day must be complete; the target PA, every other PA on the target date (including doubleheaders), and every future PA are excluded
batter_last100_whiff_rate.missing: null when the window contains zero classifiable swings; batter_last100_whiff_missing=1
batter_last100_whiff_rate.window: last min(100, prior PA count) resolved PAs for the same canonical batter

batter_prior_pa_count.calculation: count distinct canonicalPaId for the target batter after applying the strict prior-day cutoff
batter_prior_pa_count.cutoff: source.gameDate < target.game_date; the source calendar day must be complete; the target PA, every other PA on the target date (including doubleheaders), and every future PA are excluded
batter_prior_pa_count.missing: 0.0 when no eligible prior PA exists; this is an observed empty history, not an imputed rate
batter_prior_pa_count.window: all resolved PAs for the same canonical batter on completed prior dates

matchup_batter_bats_left.cutoff: target-PA handedness is resolved before the target plate appearance begins; no pitch result or target outcome is used

matchup_batter_bats_switch.calculation: 1.0 only when normalized target-PA stand explicitly equals 'S', otherwise 0.0
matchup_batter_bats_switch.cutoff: target-PA handedness is resolved before the target plate appearance begins; no pitch result or target outcome is used
matchup_batter_bats_switch.missing: 0.0 for missing/unknown stand; no switch status is inferred from names or future appearances

matchup_batter_hand_missing.calculation: 1.0 when normalized target-PA stand is not one of {L, R, S}, otherwise 0.0
matchup_batter_hand_missing.cutoff: target-PA handedness is resolved before the target plate appearance begins; no pitch result or target outcome is used
matchup_batter_hand_missing.missing: never null; it is the batter-hand missingness indicator

matchup_pitcher_hand_missing.calculation: 1.0 when normalized target-PA pThrows is not one of {L, R}, otherwise 0.0
matchup_pitcher_hand_missing.cutoff: target-PA handedness is resolved before the target plate appearance begins; no pitch result or target outcome is used
matchup_pitcher_hand_missing.missing: never null; it is the pitcher-hand missingness indicator

matchup_pitcher_throws_left.cutoff: target-PA handedness is resolved before the target plate appearance begins; no pitch result or target outcome is used

matchup_platoon_advantage.calculation: when both hands are known: 1.0 for an explicit switch batter or for opposite-side batter/pitcher hands, otherwise 0.0
matchup_platoon_advantage.cutoff: target-PA handedness is resolved before the target plate appearance begins; no pitch result or target outcome is used
matchup_platoon_advantage.missing: 0.0 when either hand is missing; matchup_batter_hand_missing and matchup_pitcher_hand_missing disambiguate

pitcher_last250_avg_fastball_velocity.calculation: arithmetic mean of finite releaseSpeed for pitches whose pitchType is in FASTBALL_PITCH_TYPES
pitcher_last250_avg_fastball_velocity.cutoff: source.gameDate < target.game_date; the source calendar day must be complete; the target PA, every other PA on the target date (including doubleheaders), and every future PA are excluded
pitcher_last250_avg_fastball_velocity.missing: null when no eligible fastball has finite releaseSpeed; pitcher_last250_velocity_missing=1
pitcher_last250_avg_fastball_velocity.window: last min(250, prior BF count) resolved batters faced by the same canonical pitcher

pitcher_last250_bf_count.cutoff: source.gameDate < target.game_date; the source calendar day must be complete; the target PA, every other PA on the target date (including doubleheaders), and every future PA are excluded

pitcher_last250_bf_count.window: last min(250, prior BF count) resolved batters faced by the same canonical pitcher
